symptom: Node micro badge, independently narrated queue cards, and missing timeline feedback obscure the same generation.
direct_cause: Consumers interpret status independently and queue producers synthesize zero percent.
class_root: No shared presentation boundary enforces exhaustive five-phase narration and real numeric evidence.
affected_population: Image, video and audio generation consumers
internal_only_reason: Approved C0/C1/C2 are an internal presentation contract; no external protocol or runtime is being introduced.
invariants: Every backend narration stage maps exhaustively to one display phase.
Unknown percentage and queue position remain absent.
Generated result adoption cannot change the visible node footprint.
generality_proof: An exhaustive mapping in the existing narration owner applies independent of provider or media kind.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the five-phase wording and truthful numeric narration.
Memoize one truthful narration per live progress snapshot and shared clock tick for all three surfaces.
Preserve the rendered footprint when adopting a generated result with different intrinsic dimensions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Queue and execution events call the same narration owner.
Generation queue entries consume the shared narration without waiting-wave/elapsed text composition.
Existing clips subscribe to their source node and consume the same narration.
Local depth processing is not a model generation stage; it retains its separately approved top progress overlay.

recurrence.reason: Every consumer can independently reinterpret progress for each future run.
same_class_scan: TimelineClip.tsx:36 has no generation status text

prevention.invariant: Every backend stage has a display phase and human narration.
prevention.failure_mode: Adding a stage without mapping fails TypeScript.
prevention.strategy: Record keyed by the full existing stage union; display wording owned by narrate.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the ten independent human-stage texts with the approved five-phase vocabulary.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal narration and existing React content layer; no new dependency.

migration: Existing backend stage identifiers remain valid; presentation derives from them.
residual_risks: No initial-generation timeline ghost clips are introduced; existing source-linked clips show feedback when generation runs again.
Typical duration uses only verified matching runs in the loaded local project; missing or insufficient provenance suppresses the hint.
True preview frames currently reach Nomi through the existing ComfyUI bridge; no Replicate provider integration is added.

invariant_owner_layer.note: User-facing generation narration owns exhaustive phase mapping and unknown numeric omission.
